verdict.rationale: vLLM ships an OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support. Every running server publishes a FastAPI OpenAPI schema and Swagger/ReDoc explorer by default. A formal deprecation policy covers the OpenAI-compatible server APIs, and community users confirm relying on that API. missing for 10: a downloadable static API spec file (the schema exists only on a running instance, and the docs omit the literal schema path), and hands-on independent verification of API coverage beyond anecdotal community praise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
